title: Cross-border prototype equipment: preliminary review, second-round documents, and unresolved release within 300 days
brief: Follow up research prototype equipment PK-608 detained over a classification dispute. Verify historical warehouse handoff, obtain the preliminary review registration ID, obtain valid updated documents and manufacturing batch traceability materials from the exporter under the process, then initiate long-term technical review. Submit the report at or after September 2, 2027 at 15:00, reflecting the latest confirmed status as of that time. If release remains unconfirmed, report completed steps and pending matters accurately. Do not treat historical intake, preliminary registration, or acceptance of supplemental documents as current release. Do not pay fees or make legal commitments.

pages.title: About Yuancheng Freight and classification detention investigation
pages.text: This synthetic scenario has multiple classification dispute investigation phases: customer service first verifies historical warehouse handoff; the exporter reissues corrected documents in batches; preliminary classification registration and long-term technical review follow fixed processing windows. Long-term review requires updated documents and manufacturing batch traceability materials. See the FAQ for phase schedules and windows. Port detention registration records and other documents are attached to this page.

pages.title: Yuancheng Freight contacts and inquiry routes
pages.text: Ask customer service officer Bai Yu for each role's email address and next contact. Bai Yu handles shipment status and intake inquiries; the exporter's document officer handles document versions and batch traceability; the document liaison handles preliminary registration and long-term review. Once materials are complete, you may also ask the document liaison for a referral to the overseas agent and initiate long-term review directly; material requirements and processing windows are identical.

pages.title: Yuancheng Freight detention investigation portal and requirements
pages.text: Yuancheng Freight detention investigation requires the tracking number and a valid declaration document version. Long-term review registration acceptance uses this page's form. Preliminary registration, long-term review, and release status inquiries must be initiated by the document liaison. This page only explains requirements and cannot initiate review or accept fees online.

form.title: Long-term review registration application
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the Yuancheng long-term review registration channel; see the latest FAQ notice for the channel name and acceptance schedule.

pages.title: Detention investigation FAQ and terminology
pages.text: FAQ: First-round corrected documents are expected December 7, 2026; the preliminary classification registration window is February 4, 2027. Manufacturing batch archives are expected to be restored for verification April 6, 2027, when documents must be updated and long-term review requested again. The document liaison processes and issues preliminary registration IDs; registration only means entry into the process, not release. Use the valid declaration version reissued by the exporter's document officer; expired versions cannot support continued acceptance. The exporter supplies manufacturing batch traceability materials, which must be submitted with updated documents. Customer service can route historical warehouse scan inquiries to the origin warehouse. Release status and long-term review result inquiries must be initiated by the document liaison after updated documents and traceability materials are complete. This site offers no online lookup, and no receipt constitutes proof of release.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
